## Design

### 2026-10-25 – # entry 1: circuit schematic design done!

**6h**

# entry 1: circuit schematic design done!

this was the first major milestone of k-OS. the goal was to turn my concept (standalone digital sound intrument thing) into a circuit and be assembled into a pcb. i needed to decide which components the instrument required as well as how they would communicate with each other.

the main components are:
- ky-040 rotary encoder
- 2 potentiometers
- PCM5012 DAC (digital to analog converter)
- esp32-s3 dev board

the esp32 generates the audio digitally, while the PCM5012 converts it into an analog output. the pots and encoder will let me change params, and the buttons provide acess to different modes/functions.

the i2s audio connections (based on the schematic guide by espressif) were:
- GPIO41 for BCLK
- GPIO40 for LRCK
- GPIO39 for data output

the rotary encoder:
- GPIO6 and 7 for rotation
- GPIO15 for the switch

GPIOs 16-18 and 8 were allocated to the push buttons.

the main challenge was completing a schematic while keeping in mind more than just the symbols (30+ errors in erc is not very encouraging :skul:) but by the end of this stage, the schematic was ready to serve as the basis for the pcb layout, and there were 0 warnings in ERC!

however, some of the breakout modules and physical components still need verivication by part numbers, although i did research into the footprints for each of the components, so it'll likely manufacture fine.
